item.text:
{
  "packet_id": "H7-T02-1",
  "claims": [
    {
      "claim_id": "C001",
      "fields": ["state"],
      "proposition": "A reconstructed applicant scheduling case is treated as the configuration, comprising a fixed application, required orientation and supervised session, applicant availability, instructor and equipment availability, and observed administrative or scheduling conditions that might be changed.",
      "scope": "The proposed unit of reconstruction and reduction.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P001"}],
      "ambiguity": "The representation of these components within a scheduling configuration is unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C002",
      "fields": ["state", "operation"],
      "proposition": "Verified, changeable administrative or scheduling conditions are candidate removable parts to be partitioned.",
      "scope": "Conditions eligible for reduction; a handoff lag must be measured and a batching rule must be documented if present.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P002"}, {"source_id": "P010"}],
      "ambiguity": "The referent of 'these conditions' in P002 is broad; P010 restricts partitioning to verified, changeable conditions. Verification criteria are unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C003",
      "fields": ["state", "limit"],
      "proposition": "Required instruction, safety checks and necessary maintenance must remain fixed; a trial that would compromise any of them must stop.",
      "scope": "All proposed reductions and trials.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P002"}, {"source_id": "P035"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not specify how a threatened compromise is detected."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C004",
      "fields": ["state"],
      "proposition": "Information collection is restricted to access-arrangement questions, with only the minimum identifying information needed to link existing step dates.",
      "scope": "Reconstruction and applicant information collection.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P003"}, {"source_id": "P004"}],
      "ambiguity": "The necessary identifying information and permitted questions are not enumerated."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C005",
      "fields": ["state", "limit"],
      "proposition": "An applicant's decision to decline further contact must be respected by stopping contact.",
      "scope": "Applicants who decline contact.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P004"}, {"source_id": "P035"}],
      "ambiguity": "None identified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C006",
      "fields": ["state", "signal", "limit"],
      "proposition": "Unknown applicant availability, ambiguous nonresponse or an unsupported scheduling assumption makes the relevant outcome unresolved; unexplained nonresponse or delay remains unknown, including after an applicant declines contact, rather than being classified as success, failure or resolution.",
      "scope": "Outcomes affected by the specified information gaps.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P004"}, {"source_id": "P017"}, {"source_id": "P035"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not specify when an uncertainty affects a particular outcome sufficiently to make it unresolved."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C007",
      "fields": ["state"],
      "proposition": "A waiting-time threshold and decision horizon must be chosen before testing.",
      "scope": "Specification of the proposed test and decision process.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P005"}],
      "ambiguity": "Neither value nor a method for choosing either is supplied."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C008",
      "fields": ["state"],
      "proposition": "Failure is defined as permission remaining unavailable beyond the chosen waiting-time threshold for a fixed applicant.",
      "scope": "The outcome tested by the reduction procedure.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P006"}],
      "ambiguity": "The starting event for measuring waiting time is not expressly specified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C009",
      "fields": ["state"],
      "proposition": "An apparent improvement obtained by excluding the applicant or resetting the waiting-time clock is not permitted.",
      "scope": "Comparisons against the defined failure for the fixed applicant.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P006"}],
      "ambiguity": "None identified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C010",
      "fields": ["state"],
      "proposition": "Whether sufficiently reproducible applicant cases exist is initially unknown.",
      "scope": "Initial applicability of the proposed reduction method.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P007"}],
      "ambiguity": "The required degree and sense of reproducibility are unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C011",
      "fields": ["state"],
      "proposition": "Whether feasible removable conditions exist is initially unknown.",
      "scope": "Initial feasibility of operational reductions.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P007"}],
      "ambiguity": "No initial inventory or feasibility criterion is provided."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C012",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Selected delayed cases are to be tested through scheduling replays with explicit assumptions about missing dates, availability and volunteer capacity.",
      "scope": "Construction of the proposed replay tests.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P008"}],
      "ambiguity": "Case-selection rules, replay mechanics and actual assumption values are unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C013",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Reduction requires an unreduced replay that reproduces the documented delay; if it does not, missing information must be investigated before reduction.",
      "scope": "The baseline prerequisite for reducing a selected case.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P009"}],
      "ambiguity": "The required agreement between replayed and documented delay is unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C014",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Removing subsets or testing their complements is to be implemented by substituting a specified feasible arrangement.",
      "scope": "Operational interpretation of candidate deletions.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P011"}],
      "ambiguity": "The correspondence between a removed condition and its replacement arrangement is not specified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C015",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Candidate substitutions must hold the applicant, required steps and other conditions fixed.",
      "scope": "Comparisons made while removing subsets or testing complements.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P011"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not explain how to hold other conditions fixed when substitutions have interacting effects."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C016",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "A reduced configuration may be retained only when repeated tests continue to reproduce the defined failure.",
      "scope": "Acceptance of reductions during the procedure.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P012"}],
      "ambiguity": "The number of repetitions and treatment of variation between repetitions are unspecified here."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C017",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Absent an earlier stopping condition, partitioning and testing continue until no single remaining condition can be removed while preserving failure.",
      "scope": "The intended reduction endpoint.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P013"}],
      "ambiguity": "The endpoint is relative to the remaining conditions and available deletion tests."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C018",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "The decision deadline, unresolved outcomes or lack of feasible substitutions can stop reduction before the single-deletion endpoint is reached.",
      "scope": "Permitted early termination of reduction.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P013"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not specify when unresolved outcomes or unavailable substitutions stop the entire procedure rather than one branch."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C019",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "A deletion without an operationally feasible counterpart is exploratory only and cannot justify changing arrangements.",
      "scope": "The practical inferential use of infeasible deletions.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P015"}],
      "ambiguity": "Operational feasibility is not formally defined."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C020",
      "fields": ["signal"],
      "proposition": "Candidate reduction outcomes distinguish failure reproduced, failure absent and unresolved.",
      "scope": "The proposed outcome classification.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P016"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not provide a complete classification rule beyond its specified uncertainty cases."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C021",
      "fields": ["signal"],
      "proposition": "A reduction may be retained as robust only if its failure classification remains stable across tests using plausible uncertain inputs.",
      "scope": "Robustness relative to the uncertain inputs tested.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P018"}],
      "ambiguity": "The plausible input range and whether a stable unresolved classification can qualify are unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C022",
      "fields": ["signal"],
      "proposition": "Where applicants consent and volunteers can support testing, promising arrangements are to be tested prospectively by comparing observed handoff and completion times with replay predictions.",
      "scope": "Conditional prospective checking of replay predictions.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P019"}],
      "ambiguity": "Criteria for promising arrangements, sufficient volunteer support and predictive agreement are unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C023",
      "fields": ["signal"],
      "proposition": "The mapping does not presume that the proposed prospective observations have occurred.",
      "scope": "The evidential status of prospective handoff and completion observations within this mapping.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P020"}],
      "ambiguity": "This does not assert that such observations are known not to exist."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C024",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "A retained subset identifies conditions jointly sufficient to reproduce excessive waiting for the fixed applicant under the specified replay and assumptions.",
      "scope": "Sufficiency within the particular replay and its assumptions.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P021"}],
      "ambiguity": "The claim does not specify sufficiency outside that replay or for other applicants."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C025",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "If every single deletion has been tested and eliminates failure, the retained subset is minimal against those deletions.",
      "scope": "Minimality relative to the tested single deletions.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P022"}],
      "ambiguity": "The operational deletion vocabulary bounds this minimality."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C026",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "Minimality against every tested single deletion does not establish that the retained subset is the smallest possible subset.",
      "scope": "The limit of the single-deletion minimality conclusion.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P022"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not define the full space of possible subsets."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C027",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "Comparing reductions across current and prospective cases is proposed as a way to identify recurring delays.",
      "scope": "Recurrence among the cases compared.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P023"}],
      "ambiguity": "Criteria for treating delays in different cases as the same recurring delay are unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C028",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "Comparing reductions across current and prospective cases is proposed as a way to identify how many applicants recurring delays affect.",
      "scope": "Applicants represented by the case comparisons; no queue-wide extrapolation is established.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P023"}],
      "ambiguity": "The intended counting population and treatment of applicants affected by multiple delays are unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C029",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "Following case comparisons, feasible allocations of the two evening slots to orientation, equipment-specific supervision or eligible intake coordination require separate tests.",
      "scope": "Evaluation of next month's allocation options.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P024"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not specify the allocation search space or test design."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C030",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "Intake coordination is an allocation option to test where evidence indicates that coordination is blocking progress.",
      "scope": "The stated condition for testing evening-slot allocation to intake coordination.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P024"}],
      "ambiguity": "The evidence required to establish blocking coordination is unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C031",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "The two evening slots are to be tested together as well as individually.",
      "scope": "Evaluation of the proposed evening-slot allocations.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P025"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not specify which combinations or individual assignments must be tested."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C032",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "Evening-slot allocation tests must preserve instructor, equipment and maintenance capacity.",
      "scope": "Feasibility constraints on individual and combined allocation tests.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P025"}],
      "ambiguity": "Capacity levels and the meaning of preserving them are unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C033",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "Next month's allocation is to be chosen using predicted reductions in excessive waits, confirmed where possible by prospective results.",
      "scope": "The proposed allocation decision rule.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P026"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not specify aggregation across applicants, tradeoffs between outcomes or the required strength of confirmation."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C034",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "A retained condition alone does not establish that adding a session will help.",
      "scope": "Inference from retained conditions to the benefit of an added session.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P027"}],
      "ambiguity": "The magnitude or form of benefit denoted by 'help' is unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C035",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "If evidence remains weak, any allocation must be a limited monitored trial with a specified review date.",
      "scope": "Allocation decisions made under continuing evidential weakness.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P028"}],
      "ambiguity": "Weak evidence, trial limits and monitoring requirements are not defined."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C036",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Replaying the same assumptions repeatedly establishes computational repeatability.",
      "scope": "Repeated replay under unchanged assumptions.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P029"}],
      "ambiguity": "The sentence does not expressly specify an agreement criterion for repeated outputs."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C037",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Replaying the same assumptions repeatedly does not establish real-world reproducibility.",
      "scope": "The evidential limit of repeated computation under unchanged assumptions.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P029"}],
      "ambiguity": "The required real-world reproducibility criterion is unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C038",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Historical reconstruction alone cannot establish the effects of changed arrangements.",
      "scope": "Inference from historical reconstruction to intervention effects.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P030"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not specify a sufficient additional evidential standard."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C039",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Interactions, cancellations, changing demand, applicant availability, missing records and reduction order can produce different retained subsets.",
      "scope": "Sensitivity of reduction results to the listed factors.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P031"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not distinguish the individual contribution of each factor or specify their effects."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C040",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Separate spreadsheets and monthly totals may support only partial reconstruction.",
      "scope": "The reconstructive adequacy of the available records.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P032"}],
      "ambiguity": "Which cases or scheduling components can be reconstructed is unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C041",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Unresolved tests do not justify forcing a minimal result.",
      "scope": "Minimality conclusions when relevant test outcomes remain unresolved.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P032"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not specify how unresolved tests delimit any narrower minimality conclusion."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C042",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Reductions from selected cases do not establish the largest source of delay across the queue.",
      "scope": "Queue-wide ranking of delay sources from selected-case reductions.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P033"}],
      "ambiguity": "The measure of 'largest' is unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C043",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Reductions from selected cases do not establish a unique cause.",
      "scope": "Causal uniqueness inferred from selected-case reductions.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P033"}],
      "ambiguity": "The sentence does not specify whether uniqueness concerns individual cases, the queue or both."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C044",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Reductions from selected cases do not establish guaranteed benefits from extra sessions.",
      "scope": "Benefit guarantees for extra sessions inferred from selected-case reductions.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P033"}],
      "ambiguity": "The benefit measure and population covered by a guarantee are unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C045",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "If prospective outcomes contradict predictions, the reconstruction must be revised and retested.",
      "scope": "The prescribed response to prospective predictive contradiction.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P034"}],
      "ambiguity": "The threshold for contradiction and the extent of revision and retesting are unspecified."
    }
  ],
  "coverage": [
    {
      "field": "state",
      "claim_ids": ["C001", "C002", "C003", "C004", "C005", "C006", "C007", "C008", "C009", "C010", "C011"],
      "unrepresented_material": [],
      "rationale": "P001–P007 are represented through the configuration correspondence, removable-part eligibility, fixed constraints, information and contact limits, unresolved outcomes, test specification and initially unknown applicability. P003's sequence of linking dates and recording handoffs, contact attempts, prerequisites, offered slots and cancellations is procedural evidence-collection setup; its identifying-information bound is represented in C004. Individual configuration components and recording categories are not separate propositions."
    },
    {
      "field": "operation",
      "claim_ids": ["C002", "C012", "C013", "C014", "C015", "C016", "C017", "C018", "C019"],
      "unrepresented_material": [],
      "rationale": "P008–P015 are represented through replay assumptions, the baseline gate, eligible conditions, feasible substitutions, comparison controls, retention criteria, endpoints and the limit on infeasible deletions. The measured handoff lag and documented batching rule in P010 are conditional examples, not assertions that either exists. P014's instruction to record stopping reasons is routine documentation setup."
    },
    {
      "field": "signal",
      "claim_ids": ["C006", "C020", "C021", "C022", "C023"],
      "unrepresented_material": [],
      "rationale": "P016–P020 are represented through the three outcome classes, uncertainty classification, robustness criterion, conditional prospective comparison and absence of presumed observations. Recording predicted permission dates, inter-step waiting and remaining blockers in P016 specifies accompanying output data; it does not assert that those quantities are known, accurate or sufficient."
    },
    {
      "field": "inference",
      "claim_ids": ["C024", "C025", "C026", "C027", "C028", "C029", "C030", "C031", "C032", "C033", "C034", "C035"],
      "unrepresented_material": [],
      "rationale": "P021–P028 are represented through replay-relative sufficiency, conditional single-deletion minimality and its size bound, the two case-comparison purposes, allocation testing and its coordination condition, combined and individual testing, capacity preservation, the decision rule, the added-session inference limit and the weak-evidence trial condition. Allocation destinations are alternatives within the proposed operation, not separate claims of effectiveness."
    },
    {
      "field": "limit",
      "claim_ids": ["C003", "C005", "C006", "C036", "C037", "C038", "C039", "C040", "C041", "C042", "C043", "C044", "C045"],
      "unrepresented_material": [],
      "rationale": "P029–P035 are represented through computational repeatability, the distinct real-world reproducibility limit, historical intervention limits, sensitivity of retained subsets, partial reconstruction, unresolved-test minimality limits, three separate selected-case inference bounds and conditional revision. P035 repeats and operationalizes the fixed safety and maintenance constraints, declined-contact rule and preservation of unexplained delay as unknown; these are consolidated with their earlier formulations."
    }
  ]
}
